summary: Iteration 2 backend-only regression. Focus: messaging TEXT+IMAGE feature. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_scoutmoi_api.py from 34 to 43 tests (all passed, 43/43, 100%). New coverage: (1) POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages with {text} only -> 200, text stored, image=null; (2) with {image} only (base64 data URI) -> 200, image stored, text=null; (3) with {} -> 400 'Message vide'; (4) with {text:null,image:null} -> 400 (extra edge case); (5) GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages returns list where every message exposes 'text' and 'image' fields; (6) GET /api/conversations last_message='📷 Photo' when last message is image-only; (7) last_message reverts to text content when a text is sent afterwards; (8) non-participant POST returns 404; (9) POST to unknown conversation returns 404. Regression on the previous 34 tests (auth register/login/me/logout, profile, athletes, offers CRUD + role guards, applications + auto-conversation, list/get/send messages, AI profile-summary + match-suggestions with role guard) still all pass. AI endpoints responded within timeout via Emergent LLM key (Claude Sonnet).

minor.issue: No size/length validation on image field. A very large base64 data URI (e.g., multi-MB) will be accepted and stored inline in MongoDB, which can bloat documents and slow GET /messages. Consider max size guard (e.g., <= 2MB base64) and mime-type/prefix validation ('data:image/...') at the API layer.
No max length on text (accepts arbitrarily long strings). Consider a reasonable cap (e.g., 4000 chars) to protect DB and UI.

Returns up to 1000 messages with full image payloads inline; combined with 2s polling this can transfer large payloads repeatedly. Consider pagination (?after=<message_id>) or stripping image and exposing via a separate endpoint.

action_items: Optional: add server-side validation for image (max base64 length, data URI prefix check) and text (max length) to prevent oversized payloads.
Optional: paginate GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages or serve image bytes separately to keep 2s polling cheap.
Prior iteration_1 items are still open (create-offer Description overlap, logout testID naming, wrap root with KeyboardProvider, migrate shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations).
critical_code_review_comments: post_message_internal correctly derives preview '📷 Photo' when image-only and text otherwise. The preview does NOT fall back to '📷 Photo' when BOTH text and image are provided — current behavior shows the text preview which is a reasonable choice.
MessageInput allows empty strings; the check `not inp.text and not inp.image` treats empty-string as falsy, so {'text':'', 'image':''} correctly 400s. Good.
conversation participant check in both GET and POST is identical (404 with 'Conversation introuvable') — consistent behavior, does not leak existence.
post_message_internal stores raw base64 data URI directly in Mongo — acceptable for MVP but see minor issues above.
